The Pre-Master's for Business, Economics, and Finance at Kaplan International College London is ideal for a postgraduate degree at university. The length of the course is determined mainly by the applicant's English language level.

All students will take a set of common or similar modules to gain key skills for university. They may also take extra modules focusing on one or more of the English language, academic skills and basic subject knowledge.

The Master of Arts in Human Resource Management is fully accredited by the Chartered Institute of Personnel Development (CIPD) and graduates will build understanding of the theory, practices and policies associated with evidence-based Human Resource Management (HRM) as they relate to real-world situations, equipping them with the knowledge, competencies and analytical skills to effectively manage organizational strategy and operations from an Human Resource (HR) perspective. Students will learn to collect and analyze relevant data and information, developing their ability to identify, evaluate and propose the most appropriate solutions looking at issues ranging from flexible working to employee engagement, managing change or reward management.

The world of marketing has been transformed by digital technology, making it easier and cheaper to target customers and track buyer behavior online. Employers need graduates ready to work in data analysis, marketing automation, user experience and content creation, some of the key skills graduates learn on the Master of Science in Digital Marketing Management. They will learn to track campaigns through analytics, develop multi-channel marketing communications and craft digital strategies with the benefit of hands-on experience in the University of Westminster's state-of-the-art digital marketing lab, Switch 23, which features the same Adobe Creative Cloud applications used in top agencies.

Economics is more relevant than ever to understand contemporary events in the global economy and provide the tools and techniques for business and governments to address the issues they face. Reflecting the needs of both private and public sector employers, the Master of Science in Economic Policy and Analysis prepares graduates to assess business problems, interpret public policy and effectively communicate the insights that economic analysis can provide. Aimed at those with a genuine interest in the application of economics to real-world situations, this course aims to provide them with an in-depth knowledge of the latest theories, practices and key concepts in economics that underpin public sector policy and business decision-making.

The Master of Science in Entrepreneurship, Innovation and Enterprise Development graduates will experience first-hand what it’s like to innovate, solving real-life problems and coming up with smart solutions. Inspired by serial entrepreneurs and the University of Westminster's academic experts, they will cultivate their entrepreneurial mindset, improving their ability to identify viable business opportunities. Individuals with an entrepreneurial spirit don’t always start up a new business, but they repeatedly come up with ideas that change the way people live and work, inspiring new products, services and activities that create jobs and spur economic growth.

The Master of Science in Finance and Accounting is designed to equip graduates with the advanced skills, knowledge, and expertise necessary for a successful career in the business and finance sectors. This practical, fully accredited, and professionally oriented program will prepare them to become a qualified chartered accountant or a corporate services specialist. Upon completion, students will benefit from Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA) and Chartered Institute of Management Accountants (CIMA) exemptions and can utilize the Bloomberg data in the University of Westminster's Financial Markets Suite (FMS) to analyze real-world financial scenarios.

The Master of Science in Fintech with Business Analytics has been designed to prepare graduates and professionals with the skills to launch a career in Financial Technology or business analytics. Graduates will gain industry-relevant expertise in blockchain, digital currencies, big data, Artificial Intelligence (AI), machine learning and more. The practical learning approach in this course will allow them to apply coding and analytics skills to real-world problems using live market data via the Bloomberg platform in the University of Westminster's state-of-the-art Financial Markets Suite (FMS). Students will be taught by academics who are actively researching the Financial Technology sector and industry experts to ensure their skills are at the forefront of this exciting and evolving area.
